LanguageData.VGE_GravitationalAnomaly.description: A powerful gravity distortion has enveloped the Hellion, preventing any launch until it subsides. The anomaly should fade within a few days, but until then the aircraft cannot leave this location.\n\nWhile the anomaly persists, the Hellion's instruments will passively collect flight data if an active Hellion-systems research project is selected.

LanguageData.VGE_Comet.description: A massive comet is passing close to the Hellion's orbital sector. Its brilliant tail lights the surrounding void and lifts the crew's spirits until it fades from view.
LanguageData.VGE_Comet.letterText: A massive comet is passing close to the Hellion's orbital sector. Its brilliant tail lights the surrounding void and lifts the crew's spirits until it fades from view.
LanguageData.VGE_AsteroidShower.description: An asteroid shower has crossed the Hellion's sector. Countless fragments streak through the void, and some will strike the airframe with explosive force.
LanguageData.VGE_AsteroidShower.letterText: An asteroid shower has crossed the Hellion's sector. Countless fragments streak through the void, and some will strike the airframe with explosive force.
LanguageData.VGE_DustCloud.description: A dense cloud of cosmic dust has drifted across the Hellion's sector. Visibility is almost zero and the targeting systems are struggling to secure a lock. The interference will end when the cloud passes.
LanguageData.VGE_DustCloud.letterText: A dense cloud of cosmic dust has drifted across the Hellion's sector. Visibility is almost zero and the targeting systems are struggling to secure a lock. The interference will end when the cloud passes.
LanguageData.VGE_ToxicDustCloud.description: A cloud of highly toxic orbital dust has enveloped the Hellion. Fine particulates are entering exposed compartments, corroding surfaces and poisoning the crew until the cloud passes.
LanguageData.VGE_ToxicDustCloud.letterText: A cloud of highly toxic orbital dust has enveloped the Hellion. Fine particulates are entering exposed compartments, corroding surfaces and poisoning the crew until the cloud passes.
